μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντήσειε: ’meet (in) battle’ (μάχης ἀντήσειε ’would meet in battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’(begin) the battle’ (ἄρχε μάχης ’begin the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of παυσώμεσθα: ’cease from battle’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with σχήσεσθαι: ’from battle’ (or governed by μεμαώς: ’eager for battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀπέληγε: ’from (the fighting)’ (ἀπέληγε μάχης ’left off the fighting’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἐπιτάρροθοι: ’helpers in battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., after ὄπισθε: ’behind the fight’ (ὄπισθε μάχης) · also fem. gen. sg., of respect after ἀκόρητοι: ’insatiate of battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἐπύθοντο: ’learned of the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., after postpositive ἄπο: ’away from the battle’ (μάχης ἄπο ’away from the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on πόνος: ’toil of battle’ (μάχης πόνος) · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἐδεύεο: ’lacking in battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., of separation, with ἐκνοστήσαντι: ’home from the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἀλεξητήρ: ’defender in battle’
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέλανα: μέλας — black, dark; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λίθον
μέλεον: μέλεος — idle, useless, in vain (elsewhere ’wretched’); acc. sg., adverbial or agreeing with an understood σέ: ’idly, to no purpose’
μέμονας: μέμονα — be eager, intend, be set on; perf. 2 sg., present force: ’you intend’
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μένει: μένος — force, might, fury; neut. dat. sg., with ἀντιόωσιν: ’my might’ · also μένω — stay, remain; pres. 3 sg.: ’stays’ · also μένω with acc.: ’awaits, waits for’ (μένει ὀξὺν Ἄρηα ’awaits keen war’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι) · also ’lest’ with a fut. indic., fear: ’lest he be angered’ (μή πως … κεχολώσεται)
μακρῷ: μακρός — long, tall; masc./neut. dat. sg.
μαχήσομαι: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall fight’
μαχοίατο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= Attic μάχοιντο), in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) they were fighting’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’) · also prep. + acc., ’among, into the midst of’ (μεθ’ ὅμιλον ’among the throng’)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’ · also + gen.: ’among’ (μετ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’among the Achaeans’) · also + acc., ’along’ (μετ’ ὄγμον ’along the swath’)
μιαιφόνος: μιαιφόνος — blood-stained, murderous (μιαίνω ’stain’ + φόνος ’slaughter’); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
μιγήμεναι: μίγνυμι — mix; pass. mingle, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic μιγῆναι): ’to lie with’ · also with ἐν + dat., ’to join, mingle in’ (μιγήμεναι ἐν δαῒ ’to join in battle’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μισθὸν: μισθός — wage, pay, reward; masc. acc. sg.
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῦνοι: μόνος (Ionic, epic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. nom. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νείκεσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, taunt, revile; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’reviled’
νεφεληγερέταο: νεφεληγερέτης — cloud-gatherer, epithet of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
νεώτερος: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’younger’
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom., epic νῶϊ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’ · also dual acc.: ’us two’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔατα: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
οὔλυμπον: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
οὔρεα: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔρεα (= Attic ὄρη)
οὔτησε: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic (cf. Attic οὔτασε): ’stabbed’
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα) · also ’that’, introducing what was learned (πεύθετο … οὕνεκ’ … ἔμελλον ’learned that they were about to’)
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg.
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’)
παισὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl.
παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’ · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond, out of the way of’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg., predicate
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περάαν: περάω — pass through, cross; pres. inf., epic περάαν with vowel stretched (diectasis) (= Attic περᾶν)
πεσών: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
πλείονα: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλείων; neut. acc. pl. πλείονα: ’more’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted (Ποσειδάων = Attic Ποσειδῶν)
ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’)
πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρότεροι: πρότερος — earlier, first (comparative of πρό); masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’first (to do it)’ · also with the article as a noun: ’the men of earlier days’ (οἱ πρότεροι)
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρόφρασσα: πρόφρων — eager, willing, ready-minded; fem. nom. sg., epic double σσ (= πρόφρασα)
πρόχνυ: πρόχνυ — down on the knees, bent forward (sense disputed); adv.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα): ἔπεα πτερόεντα ’winged words’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl.: ’thick’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with καρήαθ’: ’thick (heads)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’thickly, in quick succession’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
σκαιῇ: σκαιός — left; fem. dat. sg., with χειρί understood: ’with the left (hand)’
στήθεα: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic στήθη)
στήσεσθαι: ἵστημι — set, stand; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ὀΐω: ’to take a stand’
στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
στεῦτο: στεῦμαι — stand as if to do something; declare solemnly, vow, boast (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀμφί: ’around you’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’child’ (ἴδωμι φίλον τέκος)
τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεά: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη), accented before the enclitic τε
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’)
τρέπεν: τρέπω — turn; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, epic (= ἔτρεπε): ’turned’
τρηχύν: τρηχύς — rough, rugged; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τραχύς), agreeing with λίθον
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόξα: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single bow)
τόξον: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’bow’ (τόξον ἔκπεσε ’the bow fell’)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)
φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = ἔφατο): ’said’
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαεινώ: φαεινός — shining, bright; neut. dual acc., agreeing with ὄσσε: ’the two shining (eyes)’
φοῖβε: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, ’bright’, epithet of Apollo; masc. voc. sg.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
φύλλοισιν: φύλλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), with ἐοικότες
χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἴδε: ’delight, pleasure’ (οὔ τι χάριν ἴδε ’saw no delight’) · also fem. acc. sg. as a postpositive prep. + gen.: ’for the sake of, to please’ (χάριν Ἕκτορος)
χαίτας: χαίτη — hair, mane; fem. acc. pl.
χαλκοβατὲς: χαλκοβατής — with a bronze threshold or floor (sense somewhat uncertain); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’rejoiced’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., the greeting: ’hail, farewell’
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. after διά: ’through the hand’ (διὰ χειρός)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χολωσαμένη: χολόω — anger; mid. grow angry; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
χωομένη: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’incensed’
ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’speak’ (μὴ … ἀγόρευε ’do not speak’)
ἀδεὲς: ἀδεής — fearless, reckless, shameless (ἀ- + δέος ’fear’); fem. voc. sg. (or adverbial neut. acc.; the form allows both), in address; accent grave before the next word
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκήριοι: ἀκήριος — spiritless, lifeless (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is taken from the context, and another word of the same shape means ’unscathed’, from κήρ ’doom’); adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλόχοισι: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀντί: ἀντίος — facing, opposite; neut. acc. pl. ἀντία used as adv. + gen., elided (ἀντί’ = ἀντία): ’opposite, facing’ · also ἀντί prep. + gen. — in place of, worth as much as: ’worth as much as many peoples’
ἀντιφέρεσθαι: ἀντιφέρομαι — set oneself against, match oneself with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπειλήσας: ἀπειλέω — threaten; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having threatened’
ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’grievous’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’hard (to tell)’ (ἀργαλέον … ἀγορεῦσαι ’hard to tell’)
ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀργεϊφόντης: Ἀργεϊφόντης — ’Argeïphontes’, standing epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’slayer of Argus’; masc. nom. sg.; the meaning is disputed, not actually known
ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
ἀρούρης: ἄρουρα — ploughed land, field; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’ · also dual, of two things: ’both (hands)’
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc. · also with the impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν πω χάζοντο ’would not yet have been giving ground’) · also with the aor. indic. in the main clause of a past unreal condition: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν … ἐρρήξαντο … εἰ μὴ … ὦρσεν) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., purpose: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν … ἐξαγάγοις ’so that you might bring out’)
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρρηκτος: ἄρρηκτος — unbroken, unbreakable; adj. (2 endings), fem. nom. sg.
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἄρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead the way; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἦρχε): ’led the way’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’begin, lead off’ (ἄρχε μάχης ’begin the battle’)
ἄρῃ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic Ἄρῃ (= Attic Ἄρει), with νεμεσίζῃ: ’at Ares’ · also dat. sg. for war itself: ’in battle’ (Ἄρῃ ’in war’)
ἄψορροι: ἄψορρος — going back, back again; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’returning’
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τά: ’all (these things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’all (the army)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρημνόν: ’the whole (bank)’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναίρειν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epexegetic after an adjective: ’to slay’ · also pres. inf. after a verb of ordering: ’to slay’ (ἐκέλευεν … ἐναίρειν ’was ordering … to slay’)
ἐναντίβιον: ἐναντίβιος — face to face, in open opposition; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’face to face’
ἐννοσίγαι: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐννοσίγαι’ = ἐννοσίγαιε)
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξέφερον: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bear out; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’were bearing out’
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐούσῃ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἐούσῃ (= Attic οὔσῃ)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέσχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aorist ἐπέσχον): ’checked’
ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg. act. (augment inside the compound), + dat. + inf.: ’charged’
ἐπίκουρος: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐσαγείρετο: εἰσαγείρω — gather in, collect; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσηγείρετο): ’was gathering’
ἐτέλεσσε: τελέω — complete, accomplish, bring to pass; aor. 3 sg., epic -εσσε (= Attic ἐτέλεσε)
ἐτράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐτράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned, changed’
ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ), agreeing with πτολίεθρον
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑκάεργε: ἑκάεργος — far-working (epithet of Apollo; sense disputed, ’far-shooting’ is another guess); masc. voc. sg., in address
ἑκάεργος: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooter, epithet of Apollo (the second element is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take hold of; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτέρων: ἕτερος — other, one of two; gen. pl.: ’of others’
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔμαρπτε: μάρπτω — seize, grasp; impf. 3 sg.: ’was seizing’
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμοιγε: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’to me, for my part’
ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like’ (+ dat.: θεῇς … ἔοικεν ’is like goddesses’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται)
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl. · also ἕλιξ as a noun — spiral, coil (an ornament); masc. acc. pl.
ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.
ἠπείλησε: ἀπειλέω — threaten (+ dat., + inf.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threatened’
ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’ · also ’beat out, hammer (metal)’: ’hammered’ (πτύχας ἤλασε ’hammered out the layers’)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’)
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀνείδειον: ὀνείδειος — reproachful, abusive (ὄνειδος ’reproach’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑληέσσης: ὑλήεις — wooded, woody; fem. gen. sg. ὑληέσσης: ’wooded’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’)
ὑπερφίαλοι: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. nom. pl.
ὕπαιθα: ὕπαιθα — from beneath, aside; adv., of swerving: ’aside’ · also with a gen., ’at the side of, from beneath’ (ὕπαιθα ἄνακτος ’at their lord’s side’)
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.; personified Ὧραι, the Hours, keepers of the gates of heaven
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
